question: What do we call it when we make up our very own new steps for a song? 💃
explanation: Awesome! Choreography is the fun art of designing and creating your own special dance steps to a piece of music! 💃
hint: It is a big word that means 'dance making'.

question: What do we need to listen to carefully before we start dancing? 🎵
explanation: Great job! We listen to the music and its beat so our bodies can move in time with the song! 🎵
hint: It plays from a speaker and has a melody.

question: When we put two or more dance steps together, what do we make? 🔗
explanation: Super! A sequence is a group of dance steps that follow one after the other to make a dance! 🔗

question: Which body part do we usually tap to feel the beat of the music? 👟
explanation: Awesome! We use our feet to tap on the floor and catch the rhythm of the fun song! 👟

question: How should we feel when we show our newly created dance to our friends? 😊
explanation: Great job! Making your own dance is special, so you should feel proud and happy to share it! 😊

question: What can we show on our face to express a happy feeling in our dance? 😁
explanation: Super! A big, bright smile shows everyone watching that your dance is happy and fun! 😁
hint: It shows your teeth and happiness.

question: If the music is playing very fast, how should our dance steps be? ⚡
explanation: Awesome! When the beat is fast, we move our feet and arms quickly to match the energy! ⚡

question: If the music is slow and peaceful, how should we move our bodies? 🐢
explanation: Great job! Slow and gentle music means we make our dance steps smooth and slow! 🐢

question: What do we call the steady pulse or tap we hear in a song? 🥁
explanation: Super! The beat is like the heartbeat of the music that keeps our dance steps in time! 🥁

question: Where do dancers usually stand to perform their final dance for people to see? 🎭
explanation: Awesome! A stage is a special raised floor where dancers perform so everyone can see them! 🎭
hint: It is a raised platform with lights.

question: What do we need to do many times to remember all our dance steps perfectly? 🔁
explanation: Great job! Practice helps our muscles remember the steps so we can dance without thinking! 🔁

question: When we create a dance with our friends, what important skill do we use? 🤝
explanation: Super! Teamwork means working together kindly to make the best group dance ever! 🤝

question: What fun sound can our hands make to add extra beat to our dance? 👏
explanation: Awesome! Clapping your hands makes a sharp, happy sound that fits perfectly with the music! 👏

question: What cool sound can our feet make on the floor during a strong dance step? 👢
explanation: Great job! A loud stomp with your feet adds lots of power and energy to your dance! 👢

question: If we spin around in a full circle, what dance move are we doing? 🌀
explanation: Super! A twirl or a turn is a fun step where you spin your body all the way around! 🌀

question: If we start our dance sitting or rolling on the floor, what level are we using? ⬇️
explanation: Awesome! The low level in dance is when our bodies move close down near the floor! ⬇️

question: If we jump super high in the air during our dance, what level are we reaching? ⬆️
explanation: Great job! When we leap and jump up, we are dancing in the high space level! ⬆️

question: What special clothes can we wear to make our dance performance look colorful? 👗
explanation: Super! Costumes are special, pretty clothes that match the story or feeling of our dance! 👗

question: How do dancers politely say thank you to the clapping audience at the end? 🙇
explanation: Awesome! Bending forward in a bow is the beautiful way dancers thank the people watching! 🙇

question: What is the very first shape we hold still in before the music starts? 🧍
explanation: Great job! We hold a strong starting pose like a statue to get ready for our dance! 🧍
hint: A still statue at the beginning.

question: Who gets to be the boss and create the fun steps in 'My Dance'? 🌟
explanation: Super! When you create 'My Dance', you are the amazing choreographer of your own steps! 🌟

question: What animal move can we use if we want to hop in our dance? 🐰
explanation: Awesome! A bunny hop is a bouncy, happy step with two feet that is fun to put in a dance! 🐰
hint: It has long ears and eats carrots.

question: What helps us count the beats so we step at the right time? 🔢
explanation: Great job! Counting to 4 or 8 helps us map out our steps to match the rhythm perfectly! 🔢

question: What do we call the group of people sitting and watching our dance? 👏
explanation: Super! The audience are your friends and family who clap and cheer for your performance! 👏

question: How should we hold our bodies to show we are a strong tree in a dance? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Standing tall with strong arms makes us look like a big, beautiful tree! 🌳

question: If we want to dance like a robot, how should our arm movements be? 🤖
explanation: Great job! Robot movements are jerky, straight, and sharp, like a machine! 🤖
hint: Like a machine made of metal.

question: If we want to dance like flowing water, how should our arms move? 🌊
explanation: Super! Moving your arms in soft, smooth waves makes you look just like gentle water! 🌊

question: What kind of line do we make if we all dance holding hands in a round shape? ⭕
explanation: Awesome! Holding hands and spreading out makes a beautiful round circle formation! ⭕

question: What is the best rule to remember when creating your very own dance? ✨
explanation: Great job! Dance is all about joy, creativity, and having a wonderfully fun time! ✨

question: What do we call the space right around our own body that we dance in? 🫧
explanation: Super! Personal space is your own little bubble where you can dance without bumping friends! 🫧

question: How do we freeze at the very end of our dance song? 🛑
explanation: Awesome! Freezing like a still statue gives your dance a strong and clear ending! 🛑

question: What fun objects can we hold and wave in the air while dancing? 🎀
explanation: Great job! Dancing with pretty ribbons makes colorful trails in the air when you move! 🎀

question: What should we do before dancing to get our muscles ready? 🤸
explanation: Super! Gentle stretching warms up our muscles so we can dance safely and bend easily! 🤸

question: If our dance has three steps (Jump, Clap, Spin), what do we do after clapping? 🔄
explanation: Awesome! In a sequence, you follow the order, so spinning comes right after clapping! 🔄
hint: Look at the order: Jump, Clap, Spin.

question: What helps dancers stay together and step at the exact same time? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Listening to the same musical beat keeps everyone in the group in perfect sync! 🎶

question: What dance step involves jumping from one foot and landing on the other? 🦌
explanation: Super! A leap is a beautiful, big jump where you fly through the air from one foot to the other! 🦌

question: What is it called when we use our face to show feelings in a dance? 😊
explanation: Awesome! Expressions are how we use our eyes and mouth to tell the story without words! 😊

question: If we want to dance like a bird, what should we do with our arms? 🦅
explanation: Great job! Flapping your arms up and down makes you look just like a soaring bird! 🦅

question: What is the path our feet make on the ground as we dance around the room? 👣
explanation: Super! The invisible lines we draw on the ground with our steps are called floor patterns! 👣

question: If we move sideways step-by-step, what is that dance move called? 🦀
explanation: Awesome! A slide is a smooth step where you move sideways, just like a crab walking on the beach! 🦀

question: What healthy drink should we have after a long dance practice? 💧
explanation: Great job! Dancing makes us thirsty, so fresh water is the best drink to help us feel strong again! 💧

question: What happens if you make a tiny mistake while performing your dance? 🌟
explanation: Super! A great dancer knows that mistakes are okay! Just keep smiling and dancing along! 🌟
hint: Don't stop, just keep going joyfully.

question: What do we use to pretend we are doing something real, like picking apples, in a dance? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Mime is a fun way to pretend you are holding or doing things using only your body! 🍎

question: What kind of steps make a dance look very exciting? 🎆
explanation: Great job! Using lots of energy and making your steps big makes your dance super exciting to watch! 🎆

question: How can we safely use the whole room for our group dance? 🗺️
explanation: Super! Spreading out gives everyone enough personal space to dance beautifully and safely! 🗺️

question: When all dancers do the exact same step at the exact same time, what is it called? 👯
explanation: Awesome! Dancing 'in sync' means moving perfectly together like a team! 👯

question: What part of a song tells us it is time to do our ending pose? 🎶
explanation: Great job! The final note of the music is the perfect cue to freeze in your amazing ending pose! 🎶

question: If our dance tells a story about a seed growing, what is the best starting level? 🌱
explanation: Super! Seeds grow from the dirt, so starting low on the floor is perfect for the story! 🌱

question: What do we do to show the wind swaying the trees in our dance? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! Swaying smoothly from side to side looks just like branches blowing in the wind! 🍃

question: Who can be a great dancer and create their very own dance? 🙋
explanation: Great job! Anybody and everybody can be a dancer if they listen to the music and move with joy! 🙋
